data.description:
Casey McGuire will be releasing his debut album, Plus 30 under the name Free Trade on June 15th at TruStatement.com. 

----------------------------------------------------
Download the album here:: http://tinyurl.com/FreeTradeAlbum

Episode 1 - "Build a Booth" :: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pTP5mhkeLoQ

Episode 2 - "Find Musicians" :: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ApgEllOMlZY

Download "Beverly Drive" :: http://www.mediafire.com/?yz54hzktgz5

Download "The Right Kind" :: http://www.mediafire.com/?mmwziedamuk 
----------------------------------------------------

"I didn't find the best musicians, I found the most creative ones. I contacted as many college students from around the U.S who still believe in honest and soulful music via email, text message, and facebook, and created an entire album from my bedroom." – Free Trade

 Working within the parameters of new age media, Free Trade organized bass lines to be laid down in St. Louis, jazz samples flipped in the UK, horns tracked in Manhattan, keyboards recorded in Boston, and the list goes on. Most of the musicians involved in Plus 30 had no prior knowledge of one another, nor did they get to hear the final product until the project was finished, creating an unspoken faith between all 30 contributors. 


As a producer/emcee Free Trade's blend of motown, hip-hop, & soul has virgin listeners shocked, jazz heads baffled, and hip-hop purists nodding their heads. A warm mix of sampled vinyl and live instrumentation (guitars, horns, rhodes, turntables, upright bass, etc) is what separates Plus 30 from other hip-hop records. The level of lyricism delivered by Free Trade is a true breath of fresh air. With a cadence that follows the footsteps of Pete Rock & CL Smooth , a youthful college
sound resembling G Love & Special Sauce,  and a vocal tone similar to  Mike Posner,
Free Trade will quickly enter the music scene with an arsenal of 30 close contributors to an album sure to take over your radio and ipods.


----------------------------------------------------
Download the album here:: http://tinyurl.com/FreeTradeAlbum

Episode 1 - "Build a Booth" :: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pTP5mhkeLoQ

Episode 2 - "Find Musicians" :: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ApgEllOMlZY

Download "Beverly Drive" :: http://www.mediafire.com/?yz54hzktgz5

Download "The Right Kind" :: http://www.mediafire.com/?mmwziedamuk 
----------------------------------------------------

This is a BIG shoutout to everyone who participated in the making of this album! From beat-boxers to graphic designers, videographers to musicians... this album features all of you! This project was produced in Orlando, Florida... but was recorded all over the United States thanks to social networking, emailing, and countless phone calls. 30 people total contributed, hence the album title Free Trade - Plus 30. If you don't recognize the names of some of the people involved in this project, please friend them. They are some of the best musicians and artists I have ever worked with. The album drops June 15th at TruStatement.com. Thanks you all so much for your help with this!! Already starting the next one, let me know if you are on board!

----------------------------------------------------

data.description:
Louder The Better Productions Presents

Dinotrax Cd Release show!

Dinotrax is an Experimental Chiptune & Post-Hardcore band from Pittsburgh, Pa. They formed and began writing in September of 2008 but didn’t formally begin until January of 2009. After spending 3 months writing, Dinotrax went into to the studio to record their first EP, “There Will Be Bears”. After 2 months of recording, the EP was released online June 25, 2009 for free download. The album then proceeded to be downloaded over 500 times and Dinotrax became a very well known name in the city of Pittsburgh. After the EP was released, Dinotrax played a number of shows to support the EP including shows with Dr. Acula, The Irish Front, Motionless in White, and Corpus Christi.

In the summer of 2009, Dinotrax began writing their first full length album “Origins”. This epic album contained 11 songs along with interludes. After recording it in August of 2009, they released the album October 9th, at their very own CD release show. With their newly gained international fan base and plans to tour this summer Dinotrax is a band to watch out for.

Now the band is set to release their second full length album "Interconnected" off BRKENMIRRR Records.
